study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
exposure: Adnexal masses classified by Benign Descriptors (BDs) or ADNEX model
cohort: 291 pregnant women with adnexal mass identified on ultrasound
finding: Most adnexal masses in pregnancy can be managed expectantly, with a high spontaneous resolution rate and low complication risk, but expert subjective assessment is recommended for classification when BDs are not applicable.
